notes.title: 💥 AGENCY INTEL UPDATE: IEYTD3, Schell Games 360, PAX West, and More!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Agents!

We know you’re eagerly awaiting your return to the field! [b]Your mission clearance for [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/i] will be granted on September 28, 2023.[/b] But to help the wait not feel too long, we've got some exciting [i]IEYTD3[/i] events and intel to share with you in the meantime! Both now and coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28147648/a93859216db69bed8dd7ac537ed98f1d92ec3bec.png[/img]
Today at 3pm ET/12pm PT, we’ll be hosting our very first [b]Schell Games 360[/b] livestream. Here, you can expect a closer look at the making of [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/i] as we take you behind-the-scenes with some of the finest agents Schell Games has to offer! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Y8PVwINKVA]Tune in here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28147648/75bc0f18683bc2883f0e35fdd68166d44e2f72e3.png[/img]
Do you want more? Well, look no further!

Schell Games is excited to let our secret operatives know that we’ll be attending [url=https://west.paxsite.com/]PAX West 2023[/url] with a pop-up Agency Training booth experience! Here, fans — eh hem, Agents — will be able to meet our crew 🌟, demo the new game 🎮, update their agent codex with some cutting-edge technology 📸, and potentially walk away with [spoiler]REDACTED DUE TO HYPE LEVELS[/spoiler] at [b]Booth 2039 in the Summit building from September 1 to 4[/b].

Oh wait! — [b]I’m getting a new classified briefing from HQ... [/b]

[b]It seems ZC-07 Security Turret[/b], also known as 🐻🏹 “Bear Archer”, was successfully repurposed for Agency use. The research team is quite excited to provide agents all over the globe with a mini version of ZC-07, though we aren’t quite sure if it works just yet. At least it’s cute. 🥺 Make sure you’re following our regular correspondence channels for the latest operative updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28147648/ac5cc8ed966774da685a4e96ae19daef30253d70.png[/img]
It also seems [b]Agent Cigar Handler[/b] is expanding research around ZC-07 via [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Or6iVXMv9BM&utm_campaign=ieytd3_contentcreator_steamblog&utm_medium=youtube&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=metalaunch]Operation: Build-A-Bear[/url]. It’s unusual for agents to post their movements on YouTube of all places, but we hope he can complete the mission before his credentials are compromised. (If they aren’t already.)

You still want MORE? Fine, Agents. We can be flexible every once and awhile — but don’t misunderstand. Shawn in HR will hear about this. 

Speaking of classified intel — Agents should also keep their eyes peeled for special discounts on [url=https://iexpectyoutodie.schellgames.com/original?utm_campaign=ieytd3_ieytdwebsite_steamblog&utm_medium=website&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=metalaunch][i]I Expect You To Die[/i][/url] and [i][url=https://iexpectyoutodie.schellgames.com/sequel?utm_campaign=ieytd3_ieytd2website_steamblog&utm_medium=website&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=metalaunch]I Expect You To Die 2[/url][/i] in celebration of our launch. What can we say, Agents — we couldn’t announce everything in this briefing. (Shawn in HR wouldn’t let us.)

Stay sharp!

notes.title: 🎶 Mission Update: The I Expect You To Die 3 Opening Credits Theme DECLASSIFIED!
notes.notes:
🎶 Listen up, Agents! 

Today, [b]the Agency revealed our top secret opening credits for [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine.[/i][/b]

[previewyoutube=J4KgdaWF03E;full][/previewyoutube]
📃 [b]Featuring a declassified soulful single by singer, songwriter, and actress [url=https://www.haleyreinhart.com/]Haley Reinhart[/url][/b], Agents can now get a closer look and listen at their upcoming mission. 

Of course, we couldn’t help but to share this lovely briefing from Agent Reinhart. 🎤
[quote]“Paying homage to the 1960’s spy-fi inspired world of [i]I Expect You To Die[/i] drew me to this project initially,” said singer Haley Reinhart. “My performance was inspired by the energy of the opening sequences of the first two games along with the sweeping melodies and robust orchestral sound featured on ‘Cog In The Machine.’ It was an absolute thrill to work with such an amazing team and channel a James Bond-like vocal performance (e.g. Shirley Bassey). I can’t wait for the world to experience it!”[/quote]We’re assuming you’ve already listened, Agent and can’t get enough of the new single “Cog in the Machine” — we know, it’s glorious. Luckily for you, the Agency is also releasing the full [b][i]I Expect You To Die 3 Soundtrack[/i][/b] exclusively on our Schell Games YouTube channel. 

🎶 Listen to the full album [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLINVNan6DCzqgOGV5G3VaoNa9qHbyuRlo]here[/url] 🎶 and share your applause and favorite tracks with fellow Agents in the [url=https://discord.gg/ieytd][i]IEYTD[/i] Discord[/url]!

🦾 So we ask you again, Agents, after [i]quite literally[/i] hearing this news, will you be able to prove yourself against Dr. Roxana Prism, and her questionable robot underlings? Do you have what it takes? Will. You. Be. Ready?

For those of you who haven’t received the Agency memos yet, [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/i] launches Fall 2023 for Steam. Eager Agents can now wishlist the [i]IEYTD3[/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296380/I_Expect_You_To_Die_3/]here[/url].
